description.en: The Gliding Pokémon. The currents it creates with its wings carry the soothing scent of fresh air, calming those around it.
description.es: The Gliding Pokémon. The currents it creates with its wings carry the soothing scent of fresh air, calming those around it.

description.en: The Angel Pokémon. One kind of Ultra Beast. Belseraph's song is thought to gradually "shift" people into the afterlife if they listen for too long.
description.es: The Angel Pokémon. One kind of Ultra Beast. Belseraph's song is thought to gradually "shift" people into the afterlife if they listen for too long.

description.en: The Roughhouse Pokémon. Its keen eyes lock onto adversaries with unwavering focus, anticipating their every move in battle.
description.es: The Roughhouse Pokémon. Its keen eyes lock onto adversaries with unwavering focus, anticipating their every move in battle.

description.en: The Elementist Pokémon. Drakeon is the rarest naturally occuring Eevee evolution. Legends speak of its ability to control and manipulate elemental energies, bestowing it with an array of versatile breath attacks.
description.es: The Elementist Pokémon. Drakeon is the rarest naturally occuring Eevee evolution. Legends speak of its ability to control and manipulate elemental energies, bestowing it with an array of versatile breath attacks.

description.en: The Droid Pokémon. It was born from an experiment to save a dying Eevee. It became dramatically more observant, however, making scientists wonder how much of the original Eevee remains.
description.es: The Droid Pokémon. It was born from an experiment to save a dying Eevee. It became dramatically more observant, however, making scientists wonder how much of the original Eevee remains.

description.en: The Domesticated Pokémon. It is born from an absence of evolutionary pressure. Scientists believe increasingly more Eevees will evolve into Eeveon as human influence grows.
description.es: The Domesticated Pokémon. It is born from an absence of evolutionary pressure. Scientists believe increasingly more Eevees will evolve into Eeveon as human influence grows.

description.en: The Geodrift Pokémon. The mineral formations on its back and tail can emit an array of dazzling geoglow patterns, which are believed to be a form of communication among its kind.
description.es: The Geodrift Pokémon. The mineral formations on its back and tail can emit an array of dazzling geoglow patterns, which are believed to be a form of communication among its kind.

description.en: The Infestant Pokémon. The antennae on its head can detect differences in heat down to a tenth of a degree.
description.es: The Infestant Pokémon. The antennae on its head can detect differences in heat down to a tenth of a degree.

description.en: The Blade Shield Pokémon. Rookite protects groups of pawniards from predators both by deflecting attacks with its shield and by crushing its foes with it.
description.es: The Blade Shield Pokémon. Rookite protects groups of pawniards from predators both by deflecting attacks with its shield and by crushing its foes with it.

description.en: The Ethereal Pokémon. Its luminous, sapphire eyes exude an eerie glow, capable of entrancing those who meet its gaze.
description.es: The Ethereal Pokémon. Its luminous, sapphire eyes exude an eerie glow, capable of entrancing those who meet its gaze.

description.en: The Bone Meal Pokémon. The bones it scavenges break down in its fur over time, giving it a distinctive smell and luster.
description.es: The Bone Meal Pokémon. The bones it scavenges break down in its fur over time, giving it a distinctive smell and luster.

description.en: The Secretion Pokémon. Its fur is constantly drenched with a paralyzing toxin which, despite years of study, has no known medical use.
description.es: The Secretion Pokémon. Its fur is constantly drenched with a paralyzing toxin which, despite years of study, has no known medical use.

description.en: The Seed Pokémon. It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.
description.es: The Seed Pokémon. It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.

description.en: The Seed Pokémon. The bud on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.
description.es: The Seed Pokémon. The bud on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.

description.en: The Seed Pokémon. The flower on its back catches the sun’s rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy
description.es: The Seed Pokémon. The flower on its back catches the sun’s rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy

description.en: The Lizard Pokémon. The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.
description.es: The Lizard Pokémon. The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.

description.en: The Flame Pokémon. Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When excited, it may breathe out bluish-white flames.
description.es: The Flame Pokémon. Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When excited, it may breathe out bluish-white flames.

description.en: The Flame Pokémon. When this Pokémon expels a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
description.es: The Flame Pokémon. When this Pokémon expels a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

description.en: The Tiny Turtle Pokémon. Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
description.es: The Tiny Turtle Pokémon. Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.

description.en: The Turtle Pokémon. When tapped on its head, this Pokémon will pull it in, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
description.es: The Turtle Pokémon. When tapped on its head, this Pokémon will pull it in, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

description.en: The Shellfish Pokémon. Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
description.es: The Shellfish Pokémon. Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.

description.en: The Worm Pokémon. If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.
description.es: The Worm Pokémon. If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.

description.en: The Cocoon Pokémon. Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.
description.es: The Cocoon Pokémon. Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.

description.en: The Butterfly Pokémon. Its wings, covered with poisonous powder, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.
description.es: The Butterfly Pokémon. Its wings, covered with poisonous powder, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.

description.en: The Hairy Bug Pokémon. Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.
description.es: The Hairy Bug Pokémon. Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

description.en: The Cocoon Pokémon. Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.
description.es: The Cocoon Pokémon. Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

description.en: The Poison Bee Pokémon. It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
description.es: The Poison Bee Pokémon. It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

description.en: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.
description.es: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

description.en: The Bird Pokémon. This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.
description.es: The Bird Pokémon. This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

description.en: The Bird Pokémon. This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.
description.es: The Bird Pokémon. This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. Night after night, they sneak into people’s homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. Night after night, they sneak into people’s homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with so much food gathered by Rattata at its direction, it can’t possibly eat it all.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with so much food gathered by Rattata at its direction, it can’t possibly eat it all.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

description.en: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.
description.es: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

description.en: The Beak Pokémon. A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.
description.es: The Beak Pokémon. A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

description.en: The Snake Pokémon. The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
description.es: The Snake Pokémon. The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

description.en: The Cobra Pokémon. The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.
description.es: The Cobra Pokémon. The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. This forest-dwelling Pokémon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you’ll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. This forest-dwelling Pokémon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you’ll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. It loves pancakes prepared with a secret Alolan recipe. Some wonder whether that recipe holds the key to this Pokémon’s evolution.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. It loves pancakes prepared with a secret Alolan recipe. Some wonder whether that recipe holds the key to this Pokémon’s evolution.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

description.en: The Mouse Pokémon. It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.
description.es: The Mouse Pokémon. It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.

description.en: The Poison Pin Pokémon. A mild-mannered Pokémon that does not like to fight. Beware—its small horn secretes venom.
description.es: The Poison Pin Pokémon. A mild-mannered Pokémon that does not like to fight. Beware—its small horn secretes venom.

description.en: The Poison Pin Pokémon. When resting deep in its burrow, its barbs always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.
description.es: The Poison Pin Pokémon. When resting deep in its burrow, its barbs always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.

description.en: The Drill Pokémon. Tough scales cover the sturdy body of this Pokémon. It appears that the scales grow in cycles.
description.es: The Drill Pokémon. Tough scales cover the sturdy body of this Pokémon. It appears that the scales grow in cycles.

description.en: The Poison Pin Pokémon. Its large ears are always kept upright. If it senses danger, it will attack with a poisonous sting.
description.es: The Poison Pin Pokémon. Its large ears are always kept upright. If it senses danger, it will attack with a poisonous sting.

description.en: The Poison Pin Pokémon. Its horn contains venom. If it stabs an enemy with the horn, the impact makes the poison leak out.
description.es: The Poison Pin Pokémon. Its horn contains venom. If it stabs an enemy with the horn, the impact makes the poison leak out.

description.en: The Drill Pokémon. Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.
description.es: The Drill Pokémon. Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.

description.en: The Fairy Pokémon. Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.
description.es: The Fairy Pokémon. Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.

description.en: The Fairy Pokémon. They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.
description.es: The Fairy Pokémon. They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. If you carelessly approach it because it’s cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. If you carelessly approach it because it’s cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain’s base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain’s base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. According to an enduring legend, nine noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokémon.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. According to an enduring legend, nine noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokémon.

description.en: The Balloon Pokémon. Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.
description.es: The Balloon Pokémon. Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

description.en: The Balloon Pokémon. Its body is very elastic. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.
description.es: The Balloon Pokémon. Its body is very elastic. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.

description.en: The Bat Pokémon. Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for objects in its way.
description.es: The Bat Pokémon. Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for objects in its way.

description.en: The Bat Pokémon. It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and to suck blood.
description.es: The Bat Pokémon. It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and to suck blood.

description.en: The Weed Pokémon. It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.
description.es: The Weed Pokémon. It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.

description.en: The Weed Pokémon. Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
description.es: The Weed Pokémon. Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

description.en: The Flower Pokémon. Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.
description.es: The Flower Pokémon. Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.

description.en: The Mushroom Pokémon. Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.
description.es: The Mushroom Pokémon. Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

description.en: The Mushroom Pokémon. The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back. The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.
description.es: The Mushroom Pokémon. The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back. The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.

description.en: The Insect Pokémon. Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.
description.es: The Insect Pokémon. Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

description.en: The Poison Moth Pokémon. The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
description.es: The Poison Moth Pokémon. The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

description.en: The Mole Pokémon. Its three hairs change shape depending on Diglett’s mood. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.
description.es: The Mole Pokémon. Its three hairs change shape depending on Diglett’s mood. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

description.en: The Mole Pokémon. It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.
description.es: The Mole Pokémon. It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.

description.en: The Mole Pokémon. Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It’s reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.
description.es: The Mole Pokémon. Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It’s reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

description.en: The Mole Pokémon. A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.
description.es: The Mole Pokémon. A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.

description.en: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.
description.es: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

description.en: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.
description.es: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

description.en: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from picking them up.
description.es: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from picking them up.

description.en: The Classy Cat Pokémon. It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.
description.es: The Classy Cat Pokémon. It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

description.en: The Classy Cat Pokémon. The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
description.es: The Classy Cat Pokémon. The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.

description.en: The Duck Pokémon. Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but whether it intends to do so is not known.
description.es: The Duck Pokémon. Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but whether it intends to do so is not known.

description.en: The Duck Pokémon. Its long, slim limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.
description.es: The Duck Pokémon. Its long, slim limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.

description.en: The Pig Monkey Pokémon. An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
description.es: The Pig Monkey Pokémon. An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

description.en: The Pig Monkey Pokémon. It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
description.es: The Pig Monkey Pokémon. It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

description.en: The Puppy Pokémon. A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
description.es: The Puppy Pokémon. A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.

description.en: The Scout Pokémon. They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
description.es: The Scout Pokémon. They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

description.en: The Legendary Pokémon. A legendary Pokémon in the East. Many people are charmed by the grace and beauty of its running.
description.es: The Legendary Pokémon. A legendary Pokémon in the East. Many people are charmed by the grace and beauty of its running.

description.en: The Legendary Pokémon. Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
description.es: The Legendary Pokémon. Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

description.en: The Tadpole Pokémon. The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
description.es: The Tadpole Pokémon. The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

description.en: The Tadpole Pokémon. Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.
description.es: The Tadpole Pokémon. Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.

description.en: The Tadpole Pokémon. Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake world-class swimmers.
description.es: The Tadpole Pokémon. Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake world-class swimmers.

description.en: The Psi Pokémon. Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
description.es: The Psi Pokémon. Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

description.en: The Psi Pokémon. Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.
description.es: The Psi Pokémon. Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.

description.en: The Psi Pokémon. A Pokémon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that’s why this Pokémon is smart.
description.es: The Psi Pokémon. A Pokémon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that’s why this Pokémon is smart.

description.en: The Superpower Pokémon. Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.
description.es: The Superpower Pokémon. Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.

description.en: The Superpower Pokémon. The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this Pokémon would be unstoppable.
description.es: The Superpower Pokémon. The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this Pokémon would be unstoppable.

description.en: The Superpower Pokémon. One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this Pokémon fires off awesome punches.
description.es: The Superpower Pokémon. One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this Pokémon fires off awesome punches.

description.en: The Flower Pokémon. Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.
description.es: The Flower Pokémon. Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

description.en: The Flycatcher Pokémon. When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.
description.es: The Flycatcher Pokémon. When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

description.en: The Flycatcher Pokémon. Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.
description.es: The Flycatcher Pokémon. Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

description.en: The Jellyfish Pokémon. It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
description.es: The Jellyfish Pokémon. It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.

description.en: The Jellyfish Pokémon. Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.
description.es: The Jellyfish Pokémon. Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

description.en: The Rock Pokémon. Its stone head is imbued with electricity and magnetism. If you carelessly step on one, you’ll be in for a painful shock.
description.es: The Rock Pokémon. Its stone head is imbued with electricity and magnetism. If you carelessly step on one, you’ll be in for a painful shock.

description.en: The Rock Pokémon. Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
description.es: The Rock Pokémon. Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.

description.en: The Rock Pokémon. They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.
description.es: The Rock Pokémon. They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

description.en: The Rock Pokémon. Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
description.es: The Rock Pokémon. Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

description.en: The Megaton Pokémon. Because it can’t fire boulders at a rapid pace, it’s been known to seize nearby Geodude and fire them from its back.
description.es: The Megaton Pokémon. Because it can’t fire boulders at a rapid pace, it’s been known to seize nearby Geodude and fire them from its back.

description.en: The Megaton Pokémon. Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.
description.es: The Megaton Pokémon. Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.

description.en: The Unique Horn Pokémon. Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.
description.es: The Unique Horn Pokémon. Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

description.en: The Fire Horse Pokémon. Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
description.es: The Fire Horse Pokémon. Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.

description.en: The Unique Horn Pokémon. Fearless and proud, Rapidash uses Psychic powers stored in the flowing fur above its hooves to dash through the forest with ease.
description.es: The Unique Horn Pokémon. Fearless and proud, Rapidash uses Psychic powers stored in the flowing fur above its hooves to dash through the forest with ease.

description.en: The Fire Horse Pokémon. Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
description.es: The Fire Horse Pokémon. Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.

description.en: The Dopey Pokémon. Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.
description.es: The Dopey Pokémon. Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.

description.en: The Dopey Pokémon. Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
description.es: The Dopey Pokémon. Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.

description.en: The Hermit Crab Pokémon. A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.
description.es: The Hermit Crab Pokémon. A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.

description.en: The Hermit Crab Pokémon. Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.
description.es: The Hermit Crab Pokémon. Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.

description.en: The Magnet Pokémon. It is hatched with the ability to defy gravity. It floats while emitting powerful electromagnetic waves.
description.es: The Magnet Pokémon. It is hatched with the ability to defy gravity. It floats while emitting powerful electromagnetic waves.

description.en: The Magnet Pokémon. Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.
description.es: The Magnet Pokémon. Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

description.en: The Wild Duck Pokémon. They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch’d are rarely seen, so it’s thought their numbers are decreasing.
description.es: The Wild Duck Pokémon. They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch’d are rarely seen, so it’s thought their numbers are decreasing.

description.en: The Wild Duck Pokémon. Farfetch'd always carries a leek that is twice as long and heavy as its own body and never lets go.
description.es: The Wild Duck Pokémon. Farfetch'd always carries a leek that is twice as long and heavy as its own body and never lets go.

description.en: The Twin Bird Pokémon. Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.
description.es: The Twin Bird Pokémon. Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

description.en: The Triple Bird Pokémon. One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.
description.es: The Triple Bird Pokémon. One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

description.en: The Sea Lion Pokémon. Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: The Sea Lion Pokémon. Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

description.en: The Sea Lion Pokémon. Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
description.es: The Sea Lion Pokémon. Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

description.en: The Sludge Pokémon. Brought to Alola to solve the garbage problem, Grimer seems to relish any and all kinds of trash.
description.es: The Sludge Pokémon. Brought to Alola to solve the garbage problem, Grimer seems to relish any and all kinds of trash.

description.en: The Sludge Pokémon. Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.
description.es: The Sludge Pokémon. Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

description.en: The Sludge Pokémon. While it’s unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it’s not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer’s furnishings and eat up the fragments.
description.es: The Sludge Pokémon. While it’s unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it’s not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer’s furnishings and eat up the fragments.

description.en: The Sludge Pokémon. Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
description.es: The Sludge Pokémon. Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

description.en: The Bivalve Pokémon. The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.
description.es: The Bivalve Pokémon. The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.

description.en: The Bivalve Pokémon. For protection, it uses its harder-than-diamond shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.
description.es: The Bivalve Pokémon. For protection, it uses its harder-than-diamond shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.

description.en: The Gas Pokémon. Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape, as it appears to be made of a gas.
description.es: The Gas Pokémon. Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape, as it appears to be made of a gas.

description.en: The Gas Pokémon. By licking, it saps the victim’s life. It causes shaking that won’t stop until the victim’s demise.
description.es: The Gas Pokémon. By licking, it saps the victim’s life. It causes shaking that won’t stop until the victim’s demise.

description.en: The Shadow Pokémon. A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.
description.es: The Shadow Pokémon. A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.

description.en: The Rock Snake Pokémon. Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
description.es: The Rock Snake Pokémon. Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

description.en: The Hypnosis Pokémon. If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.
description.es: The Hypnosis Pokémon. If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

description.en: The Hypnosis Pokémon. Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
description.es: The Hypnosis Pokémon. Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

description.en: The River Crab Pokémon. Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.
description.es: The River Crab Pokémon. Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.

description.en: The Pincer Pokémon. One claw grew massively and is as hard as steel. It has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is too heavy.
description.es: The Pincer Pokémon. One claw grew massively and is as hard as steel. It has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is too heavy.

description.en: The Ball Pokémon. It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
description.es: The Ball Pokémon. It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.

description.en: The Sphere Pokémon. An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
description.es: The Sphere Pokémon. An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

description.en: The Ball Pokémon. Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
description.es: The Ball Pokémon. Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.

description.en: The Sphere Pokémon. The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
description.es: The Sphere Pokémon. The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

description.en: The Egg Pokémon. The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.
description.es: The Egg Pokémon. The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.

description.en: The Coconut Pokémon. As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.
description.es: The Coconut Pokémon. As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

description.en: The Coconut Pokémon. Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.
description.es: The Coconut Pokémon. Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.

description.en: The Lonely Pokémon. Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.
description.es: The Lonely Pokémon. Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.

description.en: The Bone Keeper Pokémon. The bones it possesses were once its mother’s. Its mother’s regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.
description.es: The Bone Keeper Pokémon. The bones it possesses were once its mother’s. Its mother’s regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

description.en: The Bone Keeper Pokémon. Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
description.es: The Bone Keeper Pokémon. Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.

description.en: The Kicking Pokémon. When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.
description.es: The Kicking Pokémon. When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.

description.en: The Punching Pokémon. Punches in corkscrew fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall like a drill.
description.es: The Punching Pokémon. Punches in corkscrew fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall like a drill.

description.en: The Licking Pokémon. Its tongue spans almost seven feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.
description.es: The Licking Pokémon. Its tongue spans almost seven feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.

description.en: The Poison Gas Pokémon. In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!
description.es: The Poison Gas Pokémon. In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!

description.en: The Poison Gas Pokémon. This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.
description.es: The Poison Gas Pokémon. This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

description.en: The Poison Gas Pokémon. This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.
description.es: The Poison Gas Pokémon. This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.

description.en: The Spikes Pokémon. A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won’t stop running until it falls asleep.
description.es: The Spikes Pokémon. A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won’t stop running until it falls asleep.

description.en: The Drill Pokémon. Its brain developed when it began walking on its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.
description.es: The Drill Pokémon. Its brain developed when it began walking on its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.

description.en: The Egg Pokémon. A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.
description.es: The Egg Pokémon. A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.

description.en: The Vine Pokémon. Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.
description.es: The Vine Pokémon. Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.

description.en: The Parent Pokémon. Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run from any fight to keep its young protected.
description.es: The Parent Pokémon. Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run from any fight to keep its young protected.

description.en: The Dragon Pokémon. If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.
description.es: The Dragon Pokémon. If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.

description.en: The Dragon Pokémon. Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.
description.es: The Dragon Pokémon. Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

description.en: The Goldfish Pokémon. When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.
description.es: The Goldfish Pokémon. When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.

description.en: The Goldfish Pokémon. It is the male’s job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.
description.es: The Goldfish Pokémon. It is the male’s job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.

description.en: The Star Shape Pokémon. As long as the center section is unharmed, this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.
description.es: The Star Shape Pokémon. As long as the center section is unharmed, this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.

description.en: The Mysterious Pokémon. The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in seven colors.
description.es: The Mysterious Pokémon. The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in seven colors.

description.en: The Dancing Pokémon. Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.
description.es: The Dancing Pokémon. Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

description.en: The Barrier Pokémon. Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.
description.es: The Barrier Pokémon. Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.

description.en: The Mantis Pokémon. Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The movement looks like that of a ninja.
description.es: The Mantis Pokémon. Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The movement looks like that of a ninja.

description.en: The Human Shape Pokémon. Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.
description.es: The Human Shape Pokémon. Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.

description.en: The Electric Pokémon. If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this Pokémon has eaten electricity at a power plant.
description.es: The Electric Pokémon. If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this Pokémon has eaten electricity at a power plant.

description.en: The Spitfire Pokémon. Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.
description.es: The Spitfire Pokémon. Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.

description.en: The Stag Beetle Pokémon. Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can’t move if it’s cold out, so it lives in warm places.
description.es: The Stag Beetle Pokémon. Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can’t move if it’s cold out, so it lives in warm places.

description.en: The Wild Bull Pokémon. A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won’t stop until it hits something.
description.es: The Wild Bull Pokémon. A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won’t stop until it hits something.

description.en: The Wild Bull Pokémon. This Pokémon blasts water from holes on the tips of its horns—the high-pressure jets pierce right through Tauros’s enemies.
description.es: The Wild Bull Pokémon. This Pokémon blasts water from holes on the tips of its horns—the high-pressure jets pierce right through Tauros’s enemies.

description.en: The Wild Bull Pokémon. When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.
description.es: The Wild Bull Pokémon. When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.

description.en: The Wild Bull Pokémon. This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent’s weak spots.
description.es: The Wild Bull Pokémon. This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent’s weak spots.

description.en: The Fish Pokémon. Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers, and shallow puddles.
description.es: The Fish Pokémon. Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers, and shallow puddles.

description.en: The Atrocious Pokémon. Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
description.es: The Atrocious Pokémon. Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.

description.en: The Transport Pokémon. A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
description.es: The Transport Pokémon. A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.

description.en: The Transform Pokémon. When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.
description.es: The Transform Pokémon. When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.

description.en: The Evolution Pokémon. Eevee’s genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokémon evolution.
description.es: The Evolution Pokémon. Eevee’s genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokémon evolution.

description.en: The Bubble Jet Pokémon. Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It melts into the water and becomes invisible.
description.es: The Bubble Jet Pokémon. Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It melts into the water and becomes invisible.

description.en: The Lightning Pokémon. A sensitive Pokémon that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.
description.es: The Lightning Pokémon. A sensitive Pokémon that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.

description.en: The Flame Pokémon. It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales, then breathes out fire that is over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: The Flame Pokémon. It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales, then breathes out fire that is over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

description.en: The Virtual Pokémon. The only Pokémon that people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.
description.es: The Virtual Pokémon. The only Pokémon that people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.

description.en: The Spiral Pokémon. An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swam by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.
description.es: The Spiral Pokémon. An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swam by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.

description.en: The Spiral Pokémon. Its sharp beak rings its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.
description.es: The Spiral Pokémon. Its sharp beak rings its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.

description.en: The Shellfish Pokémon. A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.
description.es: The Shellfish Pokémon. A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.

description.en: The Shellfish Pokémon. A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.
description.es: The Shellfish Pokémon. A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.

description.en: The Fossil Pokémon. A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
description.es: The Fossil Pokémon. A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.

description.en: The Sleeping Pokémon. Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.
description.es: The Sleeping Pokémon. Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.

description.en: The Freeze Pokémon. A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
description.es: The Freeze Pokémon. A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.

description.en: The Cruel Pokémon. Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as if they were paper.
description.es: The Cruel Pokémon. Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as if they were paper.

description.en: The Electric Pokémon. This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
description.es: The Electric Pokémon. This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.

description.en: The Strong Legs Pokémon. One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.
description.es: The Strong Legs Pokémon. One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

description.en: The Flame Pokémon. A legendary bird Pokémon. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.
description.es: The Flame Pokémon. A legendary bird Pokémon. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.

description.en: The Malevolent Pokémon. This Pokémon’s sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.
description.es: The Malevolent Pokémon. This Pokémon’s sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.

description.en: The Dragon Pokémon. Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.
description.es: The Dragon Pokémon. Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.

description.en: The Dragon Pokémon. According to a witness, its body was surrounded by a strange aura that gave it a mystical look.
description.es: The Dragon Pokémon. According to a witness, its body was surrounded by a strange aura that gave it a mystical look.

description.en: The Dragon Pokémon. It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, these are only rumors.
description.es: The Dragon Pokémon. It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, these are only rumors.

description.en: The Genetic Pokémon. Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.
description.es: The Genetic Pokémon. Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

description.en: The New Species Pokémon. When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
description.es: The New Species Pokémon. When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

description.en: The Leaf Pokémon. In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
description.es: The Leaf Pokémon. In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

description.en: The Leaf Pokémon. Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
description.es: The Leaf Pokémon. Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

description.en: The Herb Pokémon. The fragrance of Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.
description.es: The Herb Pokémon. The fragrance of Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

description.en: The Fire Mouse Pokémon. Cyndaquil protects itself by flaring up the flames on its back. The flames are vigorous if the Pokémon is angry. However, if it is tired, the flames splutter fitfully with incomplete combustion.
description.es: The Fire Mouse Pokémon. Cyndaquil protects itself by flaring up the flames on its back. The flames are vigorous if the Pokémon is angry. However, if it is tired, the flames splutter fitfully with incomplete combustion.

description.en: The Volcano Pokémon. Quilava keeps its foes at bay with the intensity of its flames and gusts of superheated air. This Pokémon applies its outstanding nimbleness to dodge attacks even while scorching the foe with flames.
description.es: The Volcano Pokémon. Quilava keeps its foes at bay with the intensity of its flames and gusts of superheated air. This Pokémon applies its outstanding nimbleness to dodge attacks even while scorching the foe with flames.

description.en: The Volcano Pokémon. Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokémon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.
description.es: The Volcano Pokémon. Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokémon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

description.en: The Ghost Flame Pokémon. Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui’s center.
description.es: The Ghost Flame Pokémon. Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui’s center.

description.en: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
description.es: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

description.en: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
description.es: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

description.en: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
description.es: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

description.en: The Scout Pokémon. When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
description.es: The Scout Pokémon. When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

description.en: The Long Body Pokémon. Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
description.es: The Long Body Pokémon. Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

description.en: The Owl Pokémon. It cries out at the same time every day. A long time ago, people cherished it and considered it a divine messenger sent to tell the time.
description.es: The Owl Pokémon. It cries out at the same time every day. A long time ago, people cherished it and considered it a divine messenger sent to tell the time.

description.en: The Owl Pokémon. When it turns its head entirely upside down, you know it’s troubled by something. If you don’t leave it be, it will peck you.
description.es: The Owl Pokémon. When it turns its head entirely upside down, you know it’s troubled by something. If you don’t leave it be, it will peck you.

description.en: The Five Star Pokémon. These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.
description.es: The Five Star Pokémon. These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

description.en: The Five Star Pokémon. It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.
description.es: The Five Star Pokémon. It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

description.en: The String Spit Pokémon. Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
description.es: The String Spit Pokémon. Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

description.en: The Long Leg Pokémon. Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.
description.es: The Long Leg Pokémon. Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

description.en: The Bat Pokémon. It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.
description.es: The Bat Pokémon. It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

description.en: The Angler Pokémon. Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.
description.es: The Angler Pokémon. Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

description.en: The Light Pokémon. It lives far down in the depths of the ocean. It blinds its prey with light, using the moment they’re dazzled to swallow them whole.
description.es: The Light Pokémon. It lives far down in the depths of the ocean. It blinds its prey with light, using the moment they’re dazzled to swallow them whole.

description.en: The Tiny Mouse Pokémon. It still can’t use electricity well. When it’s surprised or excited, it discharges electricity unintentionally.
description.es: The Tiny Mouse Pokémon. It still can’t use electricity well. When it’s surprised or excited, it discharges electricity unintentionally.

description.en: The Star Shape Pokémon. On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!
description.es: The Star Shape Pokémon. On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

description.en: The Balloon Pokémon. Left to its own devices, it will constantly practice singing. You should make it take a break so it doesn’t hurt its throat.
description.es: The Balloon Pokémon. Left to its own devices, it will constantly practice singing. You should make it take a break so it doesn’t hurt its throat.

description.en: The Spike Ball Pokémon. As its energy, Togepi uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
description.es: The Spike Ball Pokémon. As its energy, Togepi uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.

description.en: The Happiness Pokémon. Togetic is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
description.es: The Happiness Pokémon. Togetic is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.

description.en: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. The look in its eyes gives the impression that it’s carefully observing you. If you approach it, Natu will hop away.
description.es: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. The look in its eyes gives the impression that it’s carefully observing you. If you approach it, Natu will hop away.

description.en: The Mystic Pokémon. It’s said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it’s not powerful enough to change the future it sees.
description.es: The Mystic Pokémon. It’s said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it’s not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

description.en: The Wool Pokémon. Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.
description.es: The Wool Pokémon. Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

description.en: The Wool Pokémon. In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.
description.es: The Wool Pokémon. In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.

description.en: The Light Pokémon. The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.
description.es: The Light Pokémon. The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.

description.en: The Flower Pokémon. A Bellossom grows flowers more beautifully if it has evolved from a smelly Gloom-the more stinky the better. At night, this Pokémon closes its petals and goes to sleep.
description.es: The Flower Pokémon. A Bellossom grows flowers more beautifully if it has evolved from a smelly Gloom-the more stinky the better. At night, this Pokémon closes its petals and goes to sleep.

description.en: The Aqua Mouse Pokémon. When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, Marill wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This Pokémon's tail is flexible and configured to stretch.
description.es: The Aqua Mouse Pokémon. When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, Marill wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This Pokémon's tail is flexible and configured to stretch.

description.en: The Aqua Rabbit Pokémon. Azumarill's long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.
description.es: The Aqua Rabbit Pokémon. Azumarill's long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.

description.en: The Imitation Pokémon. It’s so popular with the elderly that there’s a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.
description.es: The Imitation Pokémon. It’s so popular with the elderly that there’s a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

description.en: The Frog Pokémon. The longer and more luxurious the curled hair on its head, the greater the number of Poliwag and Poliwhirl that will obey it.
description.es: The Frog Pokémon. The longer and more luxurious the curled hair on its head, the greater the number of Poliwag and Poliwhirl that will obey it.

description.en: The Cottonweed Pokémon. This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
description.es: The Cottonweed Pokémon. This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

description.en: The Cottonweed Pokémon. Skiploom's flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
description.es: The Cottonweed Pokémon. Skiploom's flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

description.en: The Cottonweed Pokémon. Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
description.es: The Cottonweed Pokémon. Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

description.en: The Long Tail Pokémon. It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.
description.es: The Long Tail Pokémon. It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

description.en: The Seed Pokémon. Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
description.es: The Seed Pokémon. Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

description.en: The Sun Pokémon. Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
description.es: The Sun Pokémon. Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

description.en: The Clear Wing Pokémon. Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
description.es: The Clear Wing Pokémon. Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.

description.en: The Water Fish Pokémon. Wooper usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.
description.es: The Water Fish Pokémon. Wooper usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.

description.en: The Poison Fish Pokémon. After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.
description.es: The Poison Fish Pokémon. After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

description.en: The Water Fish Pokémon. Quagsire hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.
description.es: The Water Fish Pokémon. Quagsire hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.

description.en: The Sun Pokémon. Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.
description.es: The Sun Pokémon. Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.

description.en: The Moonlight Pokémon. Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon's waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
description.es: The Moonlight Pokémon. Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon's waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

description.en: The Darkness Pokémon. Murkrow was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
description.es: The Darkness Pokémon. Murkrow was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.

description.en: The Hexpert Pokémon. A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Shellder's intelligence to the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.
description.es: The Hexpert Pokémon. A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Shellder's intelligence to the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.

description.en: The Royal Pokémon. Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.
description.es: The Royal Pokémon. Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.

description.en: The Screech Pokémon. Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.
description.es: The Screech Pokémon. Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.

description.en: The Symbol Pokémon. This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
description.es: The Symbol Pokémon. This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.

description.en: The Patient Pokémon. Wobbuffet does nothing but endure attacks-it won't attack on its own. However, it won't endure an attack on its tail. When that happens, the Pokémon will try to take the foe with it using Destiny Bond.
description.es: The Patient Pokémon. Wobbuffet does nothing but endure attacks-it won't attack on its own. However, it won't endure an attack on its tail. When that happens, the Pokémon will try to take the foe with it using Destiny Bond.

description.en: The Long Neck Pokémon. Girafarig's rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn't need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.
description.es: The Long Neck Pokémon. Girafarig's rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn't need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

description.en: The Bagworm Pokémon. Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.
description.es: The Bagworm Pokémon. Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.

description.en: The Bagworm Pokémon. Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell's inside cannot be seen.
description.es: The Bagworm Pokémon. Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell's inside cannot be seen.
