description.en: The Sky High Pokémon. Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.
description.es: The Sky High Pokémon. Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.

description.en: The Wish Pokémon. Jirachi will awaken from its sleep of a thousand years if you sing to it in a voice of purity. It is said to make true any wish that people desire.
description.es: The Wish Pokémon. Jirachi will awaken from its sleep of a thousand years if you sing to it in a voice of purity. It is said to make true any wish that people desire.

description.en: The DNA Pokémon. The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.
description.es: The DNA Pokémon. The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.

description.en: The Tiny Leaf Pokémon. Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
description.es: The Tiny Leaf Pokémon. Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

description.en: The Grove Pokémon. It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
description.es: The Grove Pokémon. It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

description.en: The Continent Pokémon. Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
description.es: The Continent Pokémon. Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

description.en: The Chimp Pokémon. It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
description.es: The Chimp Pokémon. It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

description.en: The Playful Pokémon. To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
description.es: The Playful Pokémon. To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

description.en: The Flame Pokémon. It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
description.es: The Flame Pokémon. It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

description.en: The Penguin Pokémon. Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
description.es: The Penguin Pokémon. Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

description.en: The Penguin Pokémon. It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
description.es: The Penguin Pokémon. It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

description.en: The Emperor Pokémon. The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
description.es: The Emperor Pokémon. The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

description.en: The Starling Pokémon. They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
description.es: The Starling Pokémon. They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

description.en: The Starling Pokémon. It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
description.es: The Starling Pokémon. It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

description.en: The Predator Pokémon. It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
description.es: The Predator Pokémon. It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

description.en: The Plump Mouse Pokémon. With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
description.es: The Plump Mouse Pokémon. With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

description.en: The Beaver Pokémon. It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
description.es: The Beaver Pokémon. It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

description.en: The Cricket Pokémon. It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
description.es: The Cricket Pokémon. It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

description.en: The Cricket Pokémon. It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
description.es: The Cricket Pokémon. It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

description.en: The Flash Pokémon. All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
description.es: The Flash Pokémon. All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

description.en: The Spark Pokémon. Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
description.es: The Spark Pokémon. Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

description.en: The Gleam Eyes Pokémon. It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
description.es: The Gleam Eyes Pokémon. It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

description.en: The Bud Pokémon. Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
description.es: The Bud Pokémon. Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

description.en: The Bouquet Pokémon. It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
description.es: The Bouquet Pokémon. It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

description.en: The Head Butt Pokémon. It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
description.es: The Head Butt Pokémon. It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

description.en: The Head Butt Pokémon. Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
description.es: The Head Butt Pokémon. Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

description.en: The Shield Pokémon. A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
description.es: The Shield Pokémon. A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

description.en: The Shield Pokémon. Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
description.es: The Shield Pokémon. Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

description.en: The Bagworm Pokémon. To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.es: The Bagworm Pokémon. To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

description.en: The Bagworm Pokémon. When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

description.en: The Moth Pokémon. It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
description.es: The Moth Pokémon. It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

description.en: The Tiny Bee Pokémon. A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.
description.es: The Tiny Bee Pokémon. A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.

description.en: The Beehive Pokémon. Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.
description.es: The Beehive Pokémon. Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

description.en: The EleSquirrel Pokémon. It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
description.es: The EleSquirrel Pokémon. It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

description.en: The Sea Weasel Pokémon. It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
description.es: The Sea Weasel Pokémon. It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

description.en: The Sea Weasel Pokémon. It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
description.es: The Sea Weasel Pokémon. It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

description.en: The Cherry Pokémon. The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
description.es: The Cherry Pokémon. The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

description.en: The Blossom Pokémon. It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
description.es: The Blossom Pokémon. It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

description.en: The Sea Slug Pokémon. Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
description.es: The Sea Slug Pokémon. Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

description.en: The Sea Slug Pokémon. It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
description.es: The Sea Slug Pokémon. It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

description.en: The Long Tail Pokémon. To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
description.es: The Long Tail Pokémon. To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

description.en: The Balloon Pokémon. A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
description.es: The Balloon Pokémon. A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

description.en: The Blimp Pokémon. It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
description.es: The Blimp Pokémon. It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

description.en: The Rabbit Pokémon. It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
description.es: The Rabbit Pokémon. It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

description.en: The Rabbit Pokémon. An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
description.es: The Rabbit Pokémon. An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

description.en: The Magical Pokémon. Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
description.es: The Magical Pokémon. Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

description.en: The Big Boss Pokémon. Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
description.es: The Big Boss Pokémon. Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

description.en: The Catty Pokémon. It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
description.es: The Catty Pokémon. It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

description.en: The Tiger Cat Pokémon. It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
description.es: The Tiger Cat Pokémon. It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

description.en: The Bell Pokémon. It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
description.es: The Bell Pokémon. It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

description.en: The Skunk Pokémon. It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
description.es: The Skunk Pokémon. It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

description.en: The Skunk Pokémon. It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
description.es: The Skunk Pokémon. It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

description.en: The Bronze Pokémon. Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
description.es: The Bronze Pokémon. Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

description.en: The Bronze Bell Pokémon. One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
description.es: The Bronze Bell Pokémon. One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

description.en: The Bonsai Pokémon. It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
description.es: The Bonsai Pokémon. It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.

description.en: The Mime Pokémon. It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
description.es: The Mime Pokémon. It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

description.en: The Playhouse Pokémon. It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
description.es: The Playhouse Pokémon. It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

description.en: The Music Note Pokémon. It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
description.es: The Music Note Pokémon. It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

description.en: The Forbidden Pokémon. A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
description.es: The Forbidden Pokémon. A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

description.en: The Land Shark Pokémon. It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
description.es: The Land Shark Pokémon. It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

description.en: The Cave Pokémon. There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
description.es: The Cave Pokémon. There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

description.en: The Mach Pokémon. When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
description.es: The Mach Pokémon. When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

description.en: The Big Eater Pokémon. It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
description.es: The Big Eater Pokémon. It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

description.en: The Emanation Pokémon. The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
description.es: The Emanation Pokémon. The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

description.en: The Aura Pokémon. It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
description.es: The Aura Pokémon. It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

description.en: The Hippo Pokémon. It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
description.es: The Hippo Pokémon. It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

description.en: The Heavyweight Pokémon. It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
description.es: The Heavyweight Pokémon. It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

description.en: The Scorpion Pokémon. It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
description.es: The Scorpion Pokémon. It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

description.en: The Ogre Scorpion Pokémon. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
description.es: The Ogre Scorpion Pokémon. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

description.en: The Toxic Mouth Pokémon. Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
description.es: The Toxic Mouth Pokémon. Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

description.en: The Toxic Mouth Pokémon. Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
description.es: The Toxic Mouth Pokémon. Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

description.en: The Bug Catcher Pokémon. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
description.es: The Bug Catcher Pokémon. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

description.en: The Wing Fish Pokémon. After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
description.es: The Wing Fish Pokémon. After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

description.en: The Neon Pokémon. It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
description.es: The Neon Pokémon. It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

description.en: The Kite Pokémon. A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
description.es: The Kite Pokémon. A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

description.en: The Frost Tree Pokémon. It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
description.es: The Frost Tree Pokémon. It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

description.en: The Frost Tree Pokémon. It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
description.es: The Frost Tree Pokémon. It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

description.en: The Sharp Claw Pokémon. They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
description.es: The Sharp Claw Pokémon. They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

description.en: The Magnet Area Pokémon. It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
description.es: The Magnet Area Pokémon. It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

description.en: The Licking Pokémon. It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
description.es: The Licking Pokémon. It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

description.en: The Drill Pokémon. It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.
description.es: The Drill Pokémon. It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

description.en: The Vine Pokémon. It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
description.es: The Vine Pokémon. It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

description.en: The Thunderbolt Pokémon. It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
description.es: The Thunderbolt Pokémon. It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

description.en: The Blast Pokémon. It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
description.es: The Blast Pokémon. It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

description.en: The Jubilee Pokémon. It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
description.es: The Jubilee Pokémon. It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

description.en: The Ogre Darner Pokémon. By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
description.es: The Ogre Darner Pokémon. By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

description.en: The Verdant Pokémon. Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
description.es: The Verdant Pokémon. Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

description.en: The Fresh Snow Pokémon. As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
description.es: The Fresh Snow Pokémon. As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

description.en: The Fang Scorpion Pokémon. It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
description.es: The Fang Scorpion Pokémon. It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

description.en: The Twin Tusk Pokémon. Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
description.es: The Twin Tusk Pokémon. Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

description.en: The Virtual Pokémon. Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
description.es: The Virtual Pokémon. Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

description.en: The Blade Pokémon. A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
description.es: The Blade Pokémon. A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

description.en: The Compass Pokémon. It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
description.es: The Compass Pokémon. It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

description.en: The Gripper Pokémon. The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
description.es: The Gripper Pokémon. The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

description.en: The Snow Land Pokémon. It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
description.es: The Snow Land Pokémon. It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

description.en: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
description.es: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

description.en: The Knowledge Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
description.es: The Knowledge Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

description.en: The Emotion Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
description.es: The Emotion Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

description.en: The Willpower Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
description.es: The Willpower Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

description.en: The Temporal Pokémon. It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
description.es: The Temporal Pokémon. It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

description.en: The Temporal Pokémon. Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.
description.es: The Temporal Pokémon. Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.

description.en: The Spatial Pokémon. It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
description.es: The Spatial Pokémon. It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

description.en: The Spatial Pokémon. It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia’s strategy for gaining Arceus’s powers.
description.es: The Spatial Pokémon. It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia’s strategy for gaining Arceus’s powers.

description.en: The Lava Dome Pokémon. It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
description.es: The Lava Dome Pokémon. It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

description.en: The Colossal Pokémon. There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
description.es: The Colossal Pokémon. There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

description.en: The Renegade Pokémon. A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
description.es: The Renegade Pokémon. A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

description.en: The Renegade Pokémon. A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
description.es: The Renegade Pokémon. A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

description.en: The Lunar Pokémon. Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description.es: The Lunar Pokémon. Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

description.en: The Sea Drifter Pokémon. A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
description.es: The Sea Drifter Pokémon. A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

description.en: The Seafaring Pokémon. Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
description.es: The Seafaring Pokémon. Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

description.en: The Pitch-Black Pokémon. It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
description.es: The Pitch-Black Pokémon. It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

description.en: The Gratitude Pokémon. It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
description.es: The Gratitude Pokémon. It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

description.en: The Gratitude Pokémon. It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
description.es: The Gratitude Pokémon. It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

description.en: The Alpha Pokémon. It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
description.es: The Alpha Pokémon. It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

description.en: The Victory Pokémon. It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.
description.es: The Victory Pokémon. It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

description.en: The Grass Snake Pokémon. They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
description.es: The Grass Snake Pokémon. They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

description.en: The Grass Snake Pokémon. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.
description.es: The Grass Snake Pokémon. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

description.en: The Regal Pokémon. They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.
description.es: The Regal Pokémon. They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

description.en: The Fire Pig Pokémon. It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.
description.es: The Fire Pig Pokémon. It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

description.en: The Fire Pig Pokémon. Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.
description.es: The Fire Pig Pokémon. Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

description.en: The Mega Fire Pig Pokémon. It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
description.es: The Mega Fire Pig Pokémon. It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

description.en: The Sea Otter Pokémon. The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.
description.es: The Sea Otter Pokémon. The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

description.en: The Discipline Pokémon. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.
description.es: The Discipline Pokémon. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

description.en: The Formidable Pokémon. Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.
description.es: The Formidable Pokémon. Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

description.en: The Formidable Pokémon. Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon’s evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
description.es: The Formidable Pokémon. Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon’s evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

description.en: The Scout Pokémon. Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.
description.es: The Scout Pokémon. Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

description.en: The Lookout Pokémon. They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.
description.es: The Lookout Pokémon. They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

description.en: The Puppy Pokémon. The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
description.es: The Puppy Pokémon. The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

description.en: The Loyal Dog Pokémon. It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.
description.es: The Loyal Dog Pokémon. It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

description.en: The Big-Hearted Pokémon. This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.
description.es: The Big-Hearted Pokémon. This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

description.en: The Devious Pokémon. Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
description.es: The Devious Pokémon. Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

description.en: The Cruel Pokémon. Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.
description.es: The Cruel Pokémon. Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

description.en: The Grass Monkey Pokémon. It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
description.es: The Grass Monkey Pokémon. It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

description.en: The Thorn Monkey Pokémon. It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
description.es: The Thorn Monkey Pokémon. It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

description.en: The High Temp Pokémon. This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.
description.es: The High Temp Pokémon. This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

description.en: The Ember Pokémon. A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
description.es: The Ember Pokémon. A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

description.en: The Spray Pokémon. It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.
description.es: The Spray Pokémon. It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

description.en: The Geyser Pokémon. The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
description.es: The Geyser Pokémon. The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

description.en: The Dream Eater Pokémon. It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.
description.es: The Dream Eater Pokémon. It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

description.en: The Drowsing Pokémon. With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.
description.es: The Drowsing Pokémon. With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

description.en: The Tiny Pigeon Pokémon. These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
description.es: The Tiny Pigeon Pokémon. These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

description.en: The Wild Pigeon Pokémon. Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
description.es: The Wild Pigeon Pokémon. Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

description.en: The Proud Pokémon. Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.
description.es: The Proud Pokémon. Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

description.en: The Electrified Pokémon. When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
description.es: The Electrified Pokémon. When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

description.en: The Thunderbolt Pokémon. This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
description.es: The Thunderbolt Pokémon. This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

description.en: The Mantle Pokémon. They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
description.es: The Mantle Pokémon. They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

description.en: The Ore Pokémon. Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
description.es: The Ore Pokémon. Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

description.en: The Compressed Pokémon. The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.
description.es: The Compressed Pokémon. The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

description.en: The Bat Pokémon. Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.
description.es: The Bat Pokémon. Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

description.en: The Courting Pokémon. Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
description.es: The Courting Pokémon. Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

description.en: The Mole Pokémon. It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
description.es: The Mole Pokémon. It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

description.en: The Subterrene Pokémon. More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
description.es: The Subterrene Pokémon. More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

description.en: The Hearing Pokémon. Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.
description.es: The Hearing Pokémon. Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.

description.en: The Muscular Pokémon. These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
description.es: The Muscular Pokémon. These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

description.en: The Muscular Pokémon. They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.
description.es: The Muscular Pokémon. They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

description.en: The Muscular Pokémon. They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.
description.es: The Muscular Pokémon. They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

description.en: The Tadpole Pokémon. By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
description.es: The Tadpole Pokémon. By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

description.en: The Vibration Pokémon. It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.
description.es: The Vibration Pokémon. It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

description.en: The Vibration Pokémon. It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
description.es: The Vibration Pokémon. It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

description.en: The Judo Pokémon. When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.
description.es: The Judo Pokémon. When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

description.en: The Karate Pokémon. Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
description.es: The Karate Pokémon. Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

description.en: The Sewing Pokémon. This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
description.es: The Sewing Pokémon. This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

description.en: The Leaf-Wrapped Pokémon. It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
description.es: The Leaf-Wrapped Pokémon. It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

description.en: The Nurturing Pokémon. It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
description.es: The Nurturing Pokémon. It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

description.en: The Centipede Pokémon. It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
description.es: The Centipede Pokémon. It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

description.en: The Curlipede Pokémon. It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.
description.es: The Curlipede Pokémon. It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

description.en: The Megapede Pokémon. Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.
description.es: The Megapede Pokémon. Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.

description.en: The Cotton Puff Pokémon. They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.
description.es: The Cotton Puff Pokémon. They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

description.en: The Windveiled Pokémon. Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.
description.es: The Windveiled Pokémon. Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

description.en: The Bulb Pokémon. Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.
description.es: The Bulb Pokémon. Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

description.en: The Flowering Pokémon. The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
description.es: The Flowering Pokémon. The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

description.en: The Spinning Pokémon. I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
description.es: The Spinning Pokémon. I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

description.en: The Hostile Pokémon. Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
description.es: The Hostile Pokémon. Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

description.en: The Hostile Pokémon. Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
description.es: The Hostile Pokémon. Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

description.en: The Mellow Pokémon. It differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor. This one is gentle.
description.es: The Mellow Pokémon. It differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor. This one is gentle.

description.en: The Desert Croc Pokémon. It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
description.es: The Desert Croc Pokémon. It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

description.en: The Desert Croc Pokémon. The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.
description.es: The Desert Croc Pokémon. The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

description.en: The Intimidation Pokémon. It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.
description.es: The Intimidation Pokémon. It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

description.en: The Zen Charm Pokémon. Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
description.es: The Zen Charm Pokémon. Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

description.en: The Zen Charm Pokémon. It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.
description.es: The Zen Charm Pokémon. It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

description.en: The Blazing Pokémon. When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.
description.es: The Blazing Pokémon. When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

description.en: The Zen Mode Pokémon. On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.
description.es: The Zen Mode Pokémon. On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

description.en: The Cactus Pokémon. Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
description.es: The Cactus Pokémon. Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

description.en: The Rock Inn Pokémon. It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
description.es: The Rock Inn Pokémon. It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

description.en: The Stone Home Pokémon. It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
description.es: The Stone Home Pokémon. It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

description.en: The Shedding Pokémon. It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.
description.es: The Shedding Pokémon. It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

description.en: The Hoodlum Pokémon. It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
description.es: The Hoodlum Pokémon. It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

description.en: The Avianoid Pokémon. The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
description.es: The Avianoid Pokémon. The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

description.en: The Spirit Pokémon. A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.
description.es: The Spirit Pokémon. A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

description.en: The Spirit Pokémon. These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.
description.es: The Spirit Pokémon. These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

description.en: The Coffin Pokémon. They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.
description.es: The Coffin Pokémon. They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

description.en: The Prototurtle Pokémon. About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
description.es: The Prototurtle Pokémon. About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.

description.en: The Prototurtle Pokémon. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.
description.es: The Prototurtle Pokémon. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

description.en: The First Bird Pokémon. Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
description.es: The First Bird Pokémon. Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

description.en: The First Bird Pokémon. It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.
description.es: The First Bird Pokémon. It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.

description.en: The Trash Bag Pokémon. The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
description.es: The Trash Bag Pokémon. The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

description.en: The Trash Heap Pokémon. They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.
description.es: The Trash Heap Pokémon. They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

description.en: The Tricky Fox Pokémon. To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
description.es: The Tricky Fox Pokémon. To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

description.en: The Spiteful Fox Pokémon. A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
description.es: The Spiteful Fox Pokémon. A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

description.en: The Illusion Fox Pokémon. Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
description.es: The Illusion Fox Pokémon. Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

description.en: The Baneful Fox Pokémon. With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark’s own body.
description.es: The Baneful Fox Pokémon. With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark’s own body.

description.en: The Chinchilla Pokémon. These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
description.es: The Chinchilla Pokémon. These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

description.en: The Scarf Pokémon. Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
description.es: The Scarf Pokémon. Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

description.en: The Fixation Pokémon. They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.
description.es: The Fixation Pokémon. They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

description.en: The Manipulate Pokémon. Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
description.es: The Manipulate Pokémon. Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

description.en: The Astral Body Pokémon. They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.
description.es: The Astral Body Pokémon. They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

description.en: The Cell Pokémon. Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.
description.es: The Cell Pokémon. Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

description.en: The Mitosis Pokémon. When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.
description.es: The Mitosis Pokémon. When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

description.en: The Multiplying Pokémon. These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.
description.es: The Multiplying Pokémon. These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

description.en: The Water Bird Pokémon. When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
description.es: The Water Bird Pokémon. When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

description.en: The White Bird Pokémon. It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.
description.es: The White Bird Pokémon. It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

description.en: The Fresh Snow Pokémon. This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.
description.es: The Fresh Snow Pokémon. This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

description.en: The Icy Snow Pokémon. It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.
description.es: The Icy Snow Pokémon. It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

description.en: The Snowstorm Pokémon. If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
description.es: The Snowstorm Pokémon. If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

description.en: The Season Pokémon. The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
description.es: The Season Pokémon. The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

description.en: The Season Pokémon. The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.
description.es: The Season Pokémon. The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

description.en: The Sky Squirrel Pokémon. They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
description.es: The Sky Squirrel Pokémon. They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

description.en: The Clamping Pokémon. When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.
description.es: The Clamping Pokémon. When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

description.en: The Cavalry Pokémon. These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
description.es: The Cavalry Pokémon. These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

description.en: The Mushroom Pokémon. For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.
description.es: The Mushroom Pokémon. For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

description.en: The Mushroom Pokémon. They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
description.es: The Mushroom Pokémon. They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

description.en: The Floating Pokémon. They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
description.es: The Floating Pokémon. They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

description.en: The Floating Pokémon. They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.
description.es: The Floating Pokémon. They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

description.en: The Caring Pokémon. Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
description.es: The Caring Pokémon. Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

description.en: The Attaching Pokémon. They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.
description.es: The Attaching Pokémon. They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

description.en: The EleSpider Pokémon. They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
description.es: The EleSpider Pokémon. They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

description.en: The Thorn Seed Pokémon. They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.
description.es: The Thorn Seed Pokémon. They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

description.en: The Thorn Pod Pokémon. They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.
description.es: The Thorn Pod Pokémon. They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

description.en: The Gear Pokémon. Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
description.es: The Gear Pokémon. Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

description.en: The Gear Pokémon. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.
description.es: The Gear Pokémon. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

description.en: The Gear Pokémon. The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
description.es: The Gear Pokémon. The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

description.en: The EleFish Pokémon. These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.
description.es: The EleFish Pokémon. These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

description.en: The EleFish Pokémon. These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
description.es: The EleFish Pokémon. These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

description.en: The EleFish Pokémon. With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
description.es: The EleFish Pokémon. With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

description.en: The Cerebral Pokémon. This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.
description.es: The Cerebral Pokémon. This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

description.en: The Cerebral Pokémon. It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.
description.es: The Cerebral Pokémon. It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

description.en: The Candle Pokémon. While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
description.es: The Candle Pokémon. While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

description.en: The Lamp Pokémon. It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.
description.es: The Lamp Pokémon. It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

description.en: The Luring Pokémon. Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
description.es: The Luring Pokémon. Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

description.en: The Tusk Pokémon. They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.
description.es: The Tusk Pokémon. They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

description.en: The Axe Jaw Pokémon. Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
description.es: The Axe Jaw Pokémon. Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

description.en: The Axe Jaw Pokémon. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.
description.es: The Axe Jaw Pokémon. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

description.en: The Chill Pokémon. Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
description.es: The Chill Pokémon. Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

description.en: The Freezing Pokémon. It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
description.es: The Freezing Pokémon. It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

description.en: The Crystallizing Pokémon. They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
description.es: The Crystallizing Pokémon. They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

description.en: The Snail Pokémon. It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.
description.es: The Snail Pokémon. It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

description.en: The Shell Out Pokémon. Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
description.es: The Shell Out Pokémon. Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

description.en: The Trap Pokémon. Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.
description.es: The Trap Pokémon. Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

description.en: The Trap Pokémon. It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
description.es: The Trap Pokémon. It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

description.en: The Martial Arts Pokémon. They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.
description.es: The Martial Arts Pokémon. They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

description.en: The Martial Arts Pokémon. They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
description.es: The Martial Arts Pokémon. They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

description.en: The Cave Pokémon. It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
description.es: The Cave Pokémon. It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

description.en: The Automaton Pokémon. These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.
description.es: The Automaton Pokémon. These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

description.en: The Automaton Pokémon. It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
description.es: The Automaton Pokémon. It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

description.en: The Sharp Blade Pokémon. They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.
description.es: The Sharp Blade Pokémon. They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

description.en: The Sword Blade Pokémon. Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
description.es: The Sword Blade Pokémon. Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

description.en: The Bash Buffalo Pokémon. They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
description.es: The Bash Buffalo Pokémon. They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

description.en: The Eaglet Pokémon. They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.
description.es: The Eaglet Pokémon. They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

description.en: The Valiant Pokémon. The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.
description.es: The Valiant Pokémon. The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

description.en: The Battle Cry Pokémon. Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water’s surface.
description.es: The Battle Cry Pokémon. Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water’s surface.

description.en: The Diapered Pokémon. They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.
description.es: The Diapered Pokémon. They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

description.en: The Bone Vulture Pokémon. Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.
description.es: The Bone Vulture Pokémon. Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

description.en: The Anteater Pokémon. Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.
description.es: The Anteater Pokémon. Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

description.en: The Iron Ant Pokémon. Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.
description.es: The Iron Ant Pokémon. Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

description.en: The Irate Pokémon. They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
description.es: The Irate Pokémon. They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

description.en: The Hostile Pokémon. Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.
description.es: The Hostile Pokémon. Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

description.en: The Brutal Pokémon. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
description.es: The Brutal Pokémon. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

description.en: The Torch Pokémon. The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.
description.es: The Torch Pokémon. The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

description.en: The Sun Pokémon. A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
description.es: The Sun Pokémon. A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

description.en: The Iron Will Pokémon. It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
description.es: The Iron Will Pokémon. It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

description.en: The Cavern Pokémon. Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
description.es: The Cavern Pokémon. Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

description.en: The Grassland Pokémon. Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
description.es: The Grassland Pokémon. Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

description.en: The Cyclone Pokémon. Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
description.es: The Cyclone Pokémon. Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

description.es: The Cyclone Pokémon. Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

description.en: The Bolt Strike Pokémon. The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
description.es: The Bolt Strike Pokémon. The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

description.en: The Vast White Pokémon. When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.
description.es: The Vast White Pokémon. When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

description.en: The Deep Black Pokémon. This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.
description.es: The Deep Black Pokémon. This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

description.en: The Abundance Pokémon. The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.
description.es: The Abundance Pokémon. The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

description.es: The Abundance Pokémon. The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

description.en: The Boundary Pokémon. It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.
description.es: The Boundary Pokémon. It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

description.es: The Boundary Pokémon. It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

description.es: The Boundary Pokémon. It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

description.en: The Colt Pokémon. It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
description.es: The Colt Pokémon. It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

description.en: The Melody Pokémon. Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.
