description.es: The Melody Pokémon. Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

description.en: The Melody Pokémon. Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.
description.es: The Melody Pokémon. Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

description.en: The Paleozoic Pokémon. This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
description.es: The Paleozoic Pokémon. This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

description.en: The Spiny Nut Pokémon. The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
description.es: The Spiny Nut Pokémon. The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

description.en: The Spiny Armor Pokémon. It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
description.es: The Spiny Armor Pokémon. It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

description.en: The Spiny Armor Pokémon. Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
description.es: The Spiny Armor Pokémon. Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

description.en: The Bubble Frog Pokémon. It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
description.es: The Bubble Frog Pokémon. It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

description.en: The Bubble Frog Pokémon. It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
description.es: The Bubble Frog Pokémon. It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

description.en: The Ninja Pokémon. It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
description.es: The Ninja Pokémon. It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

description.en: The Digging Pokémon. They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
description.es: The Digging Pokémon. They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

description.en: The Digging Pokémon. With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
description.es: The Digging Pokémon. With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

description.en: The Tiny Robin Pokémon. These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
description.es: The Tiny Robin Pokémon. These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

description.en: The Ember Pokémon. From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
description.es: The Ember Pokémon. From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

description.en: The Scorching Pokémon. In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
description.es: The Scorching Pokémon. In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

description.en: The Scatterdust Pokémon. When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
description.es: The Scatterdust Pokémon. When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

description.en: The Scatterdust Pokémon. It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
description.es: The Scatterdust Pokémon. It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

description.en: The Scale Pokémon. Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
description.es: The Scale Pokémon. Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

description.en: The Lion Cub Pokémon. The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
description.es: The Lion Cub Pokémon. The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

description.en: The Royal Pokémon. The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
description.es: The Royal Pokémon. The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

description.en: The Single Bloom Pokémon. It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
description.es: The Single Bloom Pokémon. It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

description.en: The Single Bloom Pokémon. It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
description.es: The Single Bloom Pokémon. It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

description.en: The Single Bloom Pokémon. Terrifying energy is concealed within its ominous flower, but Floette still swings it about innocently.
description.es: The Single Bloom Pokémon. Terrifying energy is concealed within its ominous flower, but Floette still swings it about innocently.

description.en: The Garden Pokémon. It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
description.es: The Garden Pokémon. It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

description.en: The Mount Pokémon. Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
description.es: The Mount Pokémon. Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

description.en: The Mount Pokémon. It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
description.es: The Mount Pokémon. It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

description.en: The Playful Pokémon. It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
description.es: The Playful Pokémon. It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

description.en: The Daunting Pokémon. Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
description.es: The Daunting Pokémon. Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

description.en: The Poodle Pokémon. Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
description.es: The Poodle Pokémon. Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

description.en: The Restraint Pokémon. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
description.es: The Restraint Pokémon. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

description.en: The Constraint Pokémon. When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description.es: The Constraint Pokémon. When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

description.en: The Constraint Pokémon. When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description.es: The Constraint Pokémon. When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

description.en: The Sword Pokémon. Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
description.es: The Sword Pokémon. Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

description.en: The Sword Pokémon. When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
description.es: The Sword Pokémon. When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

description.en: The Royal Sword Pokémon. Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description.es: The Royal Sword Pokémon. Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

description.en: The Perfume Pokémon. It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
description.es: The Perfume Pokémon. It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

description.en: The Fragrance Pokémon. It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
description.es: The Fragrance Pokémon. It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

description.en: The Cotton Candy Pokémon. To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
description.es: The Cotton Candy Pokémon. To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

description.en: The Meringue Pokémon. It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
description.es: The Meringue Pokémon. It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

description.en: The Revolving Pokémon. Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
description.es: The Revolving Pokémon. Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

description.en: The Overturning Pokémon. It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
description.es: The Overturning Pokémon. It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

description.en: The Two-Handed Pokémon. Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
description.es: The Two-Handed Pokémon. Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

description.en: The Collective Pokémon. When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
description.es: The Collective Pokémon. When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

description.en: The Mock Kelp Pokémon. Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
description.es: The Mock Kelp Pokémon. Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

description.en: The Mock Kelp Pokémon. Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
description.es: The Mock Kelp Pokémon. Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

description.en: The Water Gun Pokémon. They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
description.es: The Water Gun Pokémon. They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

description.en: The Howitzer Pokémon. Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
description.es: The Howitzer Pokémon. Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

description.en: The Generator Pokémon. They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
description.es: The Generator Pokémon. They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

description.en: The Generator Pokémon. They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
description.es: The Generator Pokémon. They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

description.en: The Royal Heir Pokémon. This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
description.es: The Royal Heir Pokémon. This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

description.en: The Despot Pokémon. Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
description.es: The Despot Pokémon. Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

description.en: The Tundra Pokémon. This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
description.es: The Tundra Pokémon. This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

description.en: The Tundra Pokémon. The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
description.es: The Tundra Pokémon. The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

description.en: The Intertwining Pokémon. It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
description.es: The Intertwining Pokémon. It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

description.en: The Wrestling Pokémon. Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
description.es: The Wrestling Pokémon. Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

description.en: The Antenna Pokémon. Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
description.es: The Antenna Pokémon. Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

description.en: The Jewel Pokémon. Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
description.es: The Jewel Pokémon. Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

description.en: The Soft Tissue Pokémon. The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.
description.es: The Soft Tissue Pokémon. The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

description.en: The Soft Tissue Pokémon. It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.
description.es: The Soft Tissue Pokémon. It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

description.en: The Snail Pokémon. A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui’s water.
description.es: The Snail Pokémon. A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui’s water.

description.en: The Dragon Pokémon. This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
description.es: The Dragon Pokémon. This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

description.en: The Shell Bunker Pokémon. Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
description.es: The Shell Bunker Pokémon. Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

description.en: The Key Ring Pokémon. These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
description.es: The Key Ring Pokémon. These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

description.en: The Stump Pokémon. These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
description.es: The Stump Pokémon. These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

description.en: The Elder Tree Pokémon. It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
description.es: The Elder Tree Pokémon. It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

description.en: The Pumpkin Pokémon. The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description.es: The Pumpkin Pokémon. The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

description.en: The Pumpkin Pokémon. Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
description.es: The Pumpkin Pokémon. Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

description.en: The Ice Chunk Pokémon. It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
description.es: The Ice Chunk Pokémon. It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

description.en: The Iceberg Pokémon. Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
description.es: The Iceberg Pokémon. Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

description.en: The Iceberg Pokémon. The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
description.es: The Iceberg Pokémon. The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

description.en: The Sound Wave Pokémon. They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
description.es: The Sound Wave Pokémon. They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

description.en: The Sound Wave Pokémon. They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
description.es: The Sound Wave Pokémon. They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

description.en: The Life Pokémon. Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description.es: The Life Pokémon. Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

description.en: The Destruction Pokémon. When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
description.es: The Destruction Pokémon. When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

description.en: The Order Pokémon. Its sharp fangs make short work of finishing off its enemies, but it's unable to maintain this body indefinitely. After a period of time, it falls apart.
description.es: The Order Pokémon. Its sharp fangs make short work of finishing off its enemies, but it's unable to maintain this body indefinitely. After a period of time, it falls apart.

description.en: The Order Pokémon. This is Zygarde's form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.
description.es: The Order Pokémon. This is Zygarde's form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.

description.en: The Order Pokémon. This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.
description.es: The Order Pokémon. This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

description.en: The Jewel Pokémon. A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description.es: The Jewel Pokémon. A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

description.en: The Mischief Pokémon. In its true form, it possesses a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
description.es: The Mischief Pokémon. In its true form, it possesses a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

description.en: The Mischief Pokémon. In its true form, it possesses a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
description.es: The Mischief Pokémon. In its true form, it possesses a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

description.en: The Steam Pokémon. It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
description.es: The Steam Pokémon. It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

description.en: The Grass Quill Pokémon. It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.
description.es: The Grass Quill Pokémon. It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

description.en: The Blade Quill Pokémon. This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.
description.es: The Blade Quill Pokémon. This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

description.en: The Arrow Quill Pokémon. It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can’t afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.
description.es: The Arrow Quill Pokémon. It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can’t afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

description.en: The Arrow Quill Pokémon. The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye’s feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui’s extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
description.es: The Arrow Quill Pokémon. The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye’s feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui’s extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

description.en: The Fire Cat Pokémon. If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.
description.es: The Fire Cat Pokémon. If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

description.en: The Fire Cat Pokémon. It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer’s whole body covered in scratches.
description.es: The Fire Cat Pokémon. It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer’s whole body covered in scratches.

description.en: The Heel Pokémon. Although it’s rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.
description.es: The Heel Pokémon. Although it’s rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

description.en: The Sea Lion Pokémon. The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.
description.es: The Sea Lion Pokémon. The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

description.en: The Pop Star Pokémon. It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.
description.es: The Pop Star Pokémon. It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

description.en: The Soloist Pokémon. To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.
description.es: The Soloist Pokémon. To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

description.en: The Woodpecker Pokémon. It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.
description.es: The Woodpecker Pokémon. It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

description.en: The Bugle Beak Pokémon. It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
description.es: The Bugle Beak Pokémon. It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

description.en: The Cannon Pokémon. They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.
description.es: The Cannon Pokémon. They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

description.en: The Loitering Pokémon. Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It’s a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
description.es: The Loitering Pokémon. Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It’s a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

description.en: The Stakeout Pokémon. Although it wasn’t originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
description.es: The Stakeout Pokémon. Although it wasn’t originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

description.en: The Larva Pokémon. If you find its nest, you shouldn’t stick your hand inside. You’ll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.
description.es: The Larva Pokémon. If you find its nest, you shouldn’t stick your hand inside. You’ll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

description.en: The Battery Pokémon. It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you’ll get a shock!
description.es: The Battery Pokémon. It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you’ll get a shock!

description.en: The Stag Beetle Pokémon. It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.
description.es: The Stag Beetle Pokémon. It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

description.en: The Boxing Pokémon. Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.
description.es: The Boxing Pokémon. Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

description.en: The Woolly Crab Pokémon. It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
description.es: The Woolly Crab Pokémon. It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

description.en: The Dancing Pokémon. It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.
description.es: The Dancing Pokémon. It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

description.en: The Dancing Pokémon. It relaxes its opponents with its elegant dancing. When they let their guard down, it showers them with psychic energy.
description.es: The Dancing Pokémon. It relaxes its opponents with its elegant dancing. When they let their guard down, it showers them with psychic energy.

description.en: The Dancing Pokémon. It lifts its opponents’ spirits with its cheerful dance moves. When they let their guard down, it electrocutes them with a jolt.
description.es: The Dancing Pokémon. It lifts its opponents’ spirits with its cheerful dance moves. When they let their guard down, it electrocutes them with a jolt.

description.en: The Dancing Pokémon. It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.
description.es: The Dancing Pokémon. It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.

description.en: The Bee Fly Pokémon. Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.
description.es: The Bee Fly Pokémon. Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

description.en: The Bee Fly Pokémon. Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.
description.es: The Bee Fly Pokémon. Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.

description.en: The Puppy Pokémon. As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.
description.es: The Puppy Pokémon. As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

description.en: The Wolf Pokémon. Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.
description.es: The Wolf Pokémon. Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

description.en: The Wolf Pokémon. The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.
description.es: The Wolf Pokémon. The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.

description.en: The Wolf Pokémon. It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn’t like. It doesn’t seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.
description.es: The Wolf Pokémon. It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn’t like. It doesn’t seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

description.en: The Small Fry Pokémon. Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name “demon of the sea.”
description.es: The Small Fry Pokémon. Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name “demon of the sea.”

description.en: The Small Fry Pokémon. They’re weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.
description.es: The Small Fry Pokémon. They’re weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.

description.en: The Brutal Star Pokémon. They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.
description.es: The Brutal Star Pokémon. They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

description.en: The Brutal Star Pokémon. To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.
description.es: The Brutal Star Pokémon. To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

description.en: The Donkey Pokémon. It loves playing in the mud. If it isn’t showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.
description.es: The Donkey Pokémon. It loves playing in the mud. If it isn’t showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.

description.en: The Draft Horse Pokémon. It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.
description.es: The Draft Horse Pokémon. It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.

description.en: The Water Bubble Pokémon. When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other’s way.
description.es: The Water Bubble Pokémon. When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other’s way.

description.en: The Water Bubble Pokémon. It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
description.es: The Water Bubble Pokémon. It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

description.en: The Sickle Grass Pokémon. When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.
description.es: The Sickle Grass Pokémon. When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

description.en: The Bloom Sickle Pokémon. For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
description.es: The Bloom Sickle Pokémon. For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

description.en: The Illuminating Pokémon. It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they’re dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.
description.es: The Illuminating Pokémon. It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they’re dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

description.en: The Illuminating Pokémon. It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.
description.es: The Illuminating Pokémon. It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.

description.en: The Toxic Lizard Pokémon. The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can’t evolve.
description.es: The Toxic Lizard Pokémon. The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can’t evolve.

description.en: The Toxic Lizard Pokémon. Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
description.es: The Toxic Lizard Pokémon. Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

description.en: The Flailing Pokémon. It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.
description.es: The Flailing Pokémon. It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

description.en: The Strong Arm Pokémon. It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn’t run away as fast as possible.
description.es: The Strong Arm Pokémon. It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn’t run away as fast as possible.

description.en: The Fruit Pokémon. Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it’s not intelligent enough to care.
description.es: The Fruit Pokémon. Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it’s not intelligent enough to care.

description.en: The Fruit Pokémon. It’s protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn’t care.
description.es: The Fruit Pokémon. It’s protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn’t care.

description.en: The Fruit Pokémon. A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.
description.es: The Fruit Pokémon. A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

description.en: The Posy Picker Pokémon. It stretches sticky vines out from its head and picks flowers to adorn itself with. When it doesn’t have any flowers, it feels uneasy.
description.es: The Posy Picker Pokémon. It stretches sticky vines out from its head and picks flowers to adorn itself with. When it doesn’t have any flowers, it feels uneasy.

description.en: The Sage Pokémon. It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.
description.es: The Sage Pokémon. It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

description.en: The Teamwork Pokémon. They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.
description.es: The Teamwork Pokémon. They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

description.en: The Turn Tail Pokémon. It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.
description.es: The Turn Tail Pokémon. It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

description.en: The Hard Scale Pokémon. The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.
description.es: The Hard Scale Pokémon. The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

description.en: The Sand Heap Pokémon. It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.
description.es: The Sand Heap Pokémon. It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

description.en: The Sand Castle Pokémon. Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they’re still alive.
description.es: The Sand Castle Pokémon. Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they’re still alive.

description.en: The Sea Cucumber Pokémon. The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.
description.es: The Sea Cucumber Pokémon. The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

description.en: The Synthetic Pokémon. A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.
description.es: The Synthetic Pokémon. A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

description.en: The Synthetic Pokémon. This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.
description.es: The Synthetic Pokémon. This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

description.en: The Meteor Pokémon. Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.
description.es: The Meteor Pokémon. Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

description.en: The Meteor Pokémon. It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.
description.es: The Meteor Pokémon. It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.

description.en: The Drowsing Pokémon. It stays asleep from the moment it’s born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
description.es: The Drowsing Pokémon. It stays asleep from the moment it’s born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

description.en: The Blast Turtle Pokémon. It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.
description.es: The Blast Turtle Pokémon. It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.

description.en: The Roly-Poly Pokémon. When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
description.es: The Roly-Poly Pokémon. When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

description.en: The Disguise Pokémon. It stands in front of a mirror, trying to fix its broken neck as if its life depended on it. It has a hard time getting it right, so it’s crying inside.
description.es: The Disguise Pokémon. It stands in front of a mirror, trying to fix its broken neck as if its life depended on it. It has a hard time getting it right, so it’s crying inside.

description.en: The Gnash Teeth Pokémon. It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.
description.es: The Gnash Teeth Pokémon. It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.

description.en: The Placid Pokémon. If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully’s house and burn it to the ground.
description.es: The Placid Pokémon. If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully’s house and burn it to the ground.

description.en: The Sea Creeper Pokémon. It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.
description.es: The Sea Creeper Pokémon. It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

description.en: The Scaly Pokémon. It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.
description.es: The Scaly Pokémon. It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

description.en: The Scaly Pokémon. It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.
description.es: The Scaly Pokémon. It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

description.en: The Scaly Pokémon. When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.
description.es: The Scaly Pokémon. When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

description.en: The Land Spirit Pokémon. Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
description.es: The Land Spirit Pokémon. Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

description.en: The Land Spirit Pokémon. As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.
description.es: The Land Spirit Pokémon. As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

description.en: The Land Spirit Pokémon. Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.
description.es: The Land Spirit Pokémon. Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

description.en: The Land Spirit Pokémon. This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.
description.es: The Land Spirit Pokémon. This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

description.en: The Nebula Pokémon. Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.
description.es: The Nebula Pokémon. Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.

description.en: The Protostar Pokémon. The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.
description.es: The Protostar Pokémon. The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.

description.en: The Sunne Pokémon. Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.
description.es: The Sunne Pokémon. Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

description.en: The Moone Pokémon. Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name “the beast that calls the moon.”
description.es: The Moone Pokémon. Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name “the beast that calls the moon.”

description.en: The Parasite Pokémon. A life-form from another world, it was dubbed an Ultra Beast and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
description.es: The Parasite Pokémon. A life-form from another world, it was dubbed an Ultra Beast and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

description.en: The Swollen Pokémon. Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description.es: The Swollen Pokémon. Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

description.en: The Lissome Pokémon. A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
description.es: The Lissome Pokémon. A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

description.en: The Glowing Pokémon. Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description.es: The Glowing Pokémon. Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

description.en: The Launch Pokémon. One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.
description.es: The Launch Pokémon. One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

description.en: The Drawn Sword Pokémon. This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
description.es: The Drawn Sword Pokémon. This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

description.en: The Junkivore Pokémon. Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description.es: The Junkivore Pokémon. Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

description.en: The Prism Pokémon. This is its form while it’s devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.
description.es: The Prism Pokémon. This is its form while it’s devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.

description.en: The Prism Pokémon. This is Necrozma’s form while it’s absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.
description.es: The Prism Pokémon. This is Necrozma’s form while it’s absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.

description.en: The Prism Pokémon. It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It’s apparently from another world.
description.es: The Prism Pokémon. It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It’s apparently from another world.

description.en: The Prism Pokémon. The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.
description.es: The Prism Pokémon. The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

description.en: The Artificial Pokémon. It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.
description.es: The Artificial Pokémon. It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

description.en: The Gloomdweller Pokémon. It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it’s imitating.
description.es: The Gloomdweller Pokémon. It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it’s imitating.

description.en: The Poison Pin Pokémon. An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
description.es: The Poison Pin Pokémon. An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

description.en: The Poison Pin Pokémon. One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
description.es: The Poison Pin Pokémon. One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

description.en: The Rampart Pokémon. It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
description.es: The Rampart Pokémon. It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

description.en: The Fireworks Pokémon. It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
description.es: The Fireworks Pokémon. It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

description.en: The Thunderclap Pokémon. It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
description.es: The Thunderclap Pokémon. It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

description.en: The Hex Nut Pokémon. It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
description.es: The Hex Nut Pokémon. It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

description.en: The Hex Nut Pokémon. At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.
description.es: The Hex Nut Pokémon. At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

description.en: The Chimp Pokémon. Grookey attacks by beating with a stick. As the speed of its beats increases, Grookey's excitement does too.
description.es: The Chimp Pokémon. Grookey attacks by beating with a stick. As the speed of its beats increases, Grookey's excitement does too.

description.en: The Beat Pokémon. The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
description.es: The Beat Pokémon. The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

description.en: The Drummer Pokémon. By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
description.es: The Drummer Pokémon. By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

description.en: The Rabbit Pokémon. A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
description.es: The Rabbit Pokémon. A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

description.en: The Rabbit Pokémon. It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
description.es: The Rabbit Pokémon. It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

description.en: The Striker Pokémon. It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
description.es: The Striker Pokémon. It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

description.en: The Water Lizard Pokémon. When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
description.es: The Water Lizard Pokémon. When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

description.en: The Water Lizard Pokémon. A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
description.es: The Water Lizard Pokémon. A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

description.en: The Secret Agent Pokémon. It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
description.es: The Secret Agent Pokémon. It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

description.en: The Cheeky Pokémon. It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.
description.es: The Cheeky Pokémon. It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

description.en: The Greedy Pokémon. It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.
description.es: The Greedy Pokémon. It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

description.en: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
description.es: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

description.en: The Raven Pokémon. Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
description.es: The Raven Pokémon. Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

description.en: The Raven Pokémon. With their great intellect and flying skills, the black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
description.es: The Raven Pokémon. With their great intellect and flying skills, the black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

description.en: The Larva Pokémon. Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
description.es: The Larva Pokémon. Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

description.en: The Radome Pokémon. It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
description.es: The Radome Pokémon. It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

description.en: The Seven Spot Pokémon. It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
description.es: The Seven Spot Pokémon. It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

description.en: The Fox Pokémon. It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
description.es: The Fox Pokémon. It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

description.en: The Flowering Pokémon. It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
description.es: The Flowering Pokémon. It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

description.en: The Cotton Bloom Pokémon. The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
description.es: The Cotton Bloom Pokémon. The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

description.en: The Sheep Pokémon. Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
description.es: The Sheep Pokémon. Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

description.en: The Sheep Pokémon. Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
description.es: The Sheep Pokémon. Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

description.en: The Snapping Pokémon. It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
description.es: The Snapping Pokémon. It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

description.en: The Bite Pokémon. With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
description.es: The Bite Pokémon. With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

description.en: The Puppy Pokémon. This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
description.es: The Puppy Pokémon. This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

description.en: The Dog Pokémon. This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
description.es: The Dog Pokémon. This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

description.en: The Coal Pokémon. Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
description.es: The Coal Pokémon. Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

description.en: The Coal Pokémon. By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: The Coal Pokémon. By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

description.en: The Coal Pokémon. While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
description.es: The Coal Pokémon. While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

description.en: The Apple Core Pokémon. It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.
description.es: The Apple Core Pokémon. It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

description.en: The Apple Wing Pokémon. It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
description.es: The Apple Wing Pokémon. It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

description.en: The Apple Nectar Pokémon. Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
description.es: The Apple Nectar Pokémon. Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

description.en: The Sand Snake Pokémon. As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
description.es: The Sand Snake Pokémon. As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

description.en: The Sand Snake Pokémon. When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
description.es: The Sand Snake Pokémon. When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

description.en: The Gulp Pokémon. This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
description.es: The Gulp Pokémon. This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

description.en: The Rush Pokémon. If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
description.es: The Rush Pokémon. If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

description.en: The Skewer Pokémon. It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
description.es: The Skewer Pokémon. It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

description.en: The Baby Pokémon. It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
description.es: The Baby Pokémon. It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

description.en: The Punk Pokémon. This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
description.es: The Punk Pokémon. This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

description.en: The Punk Pokémon. Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.
description.es: The Punk Pokémon. Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

description.en: The Radiator Pokémon. It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
description.es: The Radiator Pokémon. It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

description.en: The Radiator Pokémon. When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
description.es: The Radiator Pokémon. When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

description.en: The Tantrum Pokémon. It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
description.es: The Tantrum Pokémon. It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

description.en: The Tantrum Pokémon. A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
description.es: The Tantrum Pokémon. A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

description.en: The Black Tea Pokémon. This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
description.es: The Black Tea Pokémon. This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

description.en: The Black Tea Pokémon. This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
description.es: The Black Tea Pokémon. This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

description.en: The Calm Pokémon. Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
description.es: The Calm Pokémon. Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

description.en: The Serene Pokémon. No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
description.es: The Serene Pokémon. No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

description.en: The Silent Pokémon. It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
description.es: The Silent Pokémon. It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

description.en: The Wily Pokémon. Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
description.es: The Wily Pokémon. Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

description.en: The Devious Pokémon. When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
description.es: The Devious Pokémon. When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

description.en: The Bulk Up Pokémon. With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
description.es: The Bulk Up Pokémon. With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

description.en: The Blocking Pokémon. It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
description.es: The Blocking Pokémon. It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

description.en: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
description.es: The Scratch Cat Pokémon. What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

description.en: The Coral Pokémon. Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.
description.es: The Coral Pokémon. Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

description.en: The Wild Duck Pokémon. Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.
description.es: The Wild Duck Pokémon. Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

description.en: The Dancing Pokémon. It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
description.es: The Dancing Pokémon. It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

description.en: The Grudge Pokémon. Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
description.es: The Grudge Pokémon. Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

description.en: The Cream Pokémon. They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
description.es: The Cream Pokémon. They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

description.en: The Cream Pokémon. Alcremie can produce whipped cream, which becomes richer the happier Alcremie is feeling. Desserts made using this cream are invariably delicious, so many pastry chefs strive to have an Alcremie as their partner.
description.es: The Cream Pokémon. Alcremie can produce whipped cream, which becomes richer the happier Alcremie is feeling. Desserts made using this cream are invariably delicious, so many pastry chefs strive to have an Alcremie as their partner.

description.en: The Formation Pokémon. The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.
description.es: The Formation Pokémon. The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

description.en: The Sea Urchin Pokémon. This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.
description.es: The Sea Urchin Pokémon. This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

description.en: The Worm Pokemon. Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.
description.es: The Worm Pokemon. Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

description.en: The Frost Moth Pokémon. Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: The Frost Moth Pokémon. Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

description.en: The Big Rock Pokémon. It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
description.es: The Big Rock Pokémon. It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

description.en: The Penguin Pokémon. It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
