description.es: The Penguin Pokémon. It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

description.en: The Emotion Pokémon. They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.
description.es: The Emotion Pokémon. They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

description.en: The Emotion Pokémon. It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
description.es: The Emotion Pokémon. It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

description.en: The Two-Sided Pokémon. As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
description.es: The Two-Sided Pokémon. As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.

description.en: The Copperderm Pokémon. It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
description.es: The Copperderm Pokémon. It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

description.en: The Copperderm Pokémon. They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
description.es: The Copperderm Pokémon. They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

description.en: The Fossil Pokémon. In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
description.es: The Fossil Pokémon. In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

description.en: The Fossil Pokémon. The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
description.es: The Fossil Pokémon. The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

description.en: The Fossil Pokémon. Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
description.es: The Fossil Pokémon. Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

description.en: The Fossil Pokémon. Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
description.es: The Fossil Pokémon. Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

description.en: The Alloy Pokémon. Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
description.es: The Alloy Pokémon. Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

description.en: The Lingering Pokémon. After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
description.es: The Lingering Pokémon. After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

description.en: The Caretaker Pokémon. It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
description.es: The Caretaker Pokémon. It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

description.en: The Stealth Pokémon. When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
description.es: The Stealth Pokémon. When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

description.en: The Warrior Pokémon. Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
description.es: The Warrior Pokémon. Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

description.en: The Warrior Pokémon. Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
description.es: The Warrior Pokémon. Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

description.en: The Warrior Pokémon. In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
description.es: The Warrior Pokémon. In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

description.es: The Warrior Pokémon. In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

description.en: The Gigantic Pokémon. The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
description.es: The Gigantic Pokémon. The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

description.es: The Gigantic Pokémon. The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

description.en: The Wushu Pokémon. Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
description.es: The Wushu Pokémon. Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

description.en: The Wushu Pokémon. This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.
description.es: The Wushu Pokémon. This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

description.en: The Wushu Pokémon. This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
description.es: The Wushu Pokémon. This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

description.en: The Rogue Monkey Pokémon. Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
description.es: The Rogue Monkey Pokémon. Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

description.en: The Electron Pokémon. This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
description.es: The Electron Pokémon. This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.

description.en: The Dragon Orb Pokémon. An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
description.es: The Dragon Orb Pokémon. An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

description.en: The Wild Horse Pokémon. Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
description.es: The Wild Horse Pokémon. Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

description.en: The Swift Horse Pokémon. It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
description.es: The Swift Horse Pokémon. It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

description.en: The King Pokémon. Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
description.es: The King Pokémon. Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

description.en: The High King Pokémon. According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents’ wounds after battle.
description.es: The High King Pokémon. According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents’ wounds after battle.

description.en: The High King Pokémon. Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.
description.es: The High King Pokémon. Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.

description.en: The Big Horn Pokémon. The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
description.es: The Big Horn Pokémon. The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

description.en: The Axe Pokémon. A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
description.es: The Axe Pokémon. A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

description.en: The Peat Pokémon. I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
description.es: The Peat Pokémon. I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

description.en: The Peat Pokémon. This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.
description.es: The Peat Pokémon. This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.

description.en: The Big Fish Pokémon. Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
description.es: The Big Fish Pokémon. Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

description.es: The Big Fish Pokémon. Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

description.en: The Free Climb Pokémon. Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
description.es: The Free Climb Pokémon. Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

description.en: The Pin Cluster Pokémon. Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
description.es: The Pin Cluster Pokémon. Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

description.en: The Love-Hate Pokémon. When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
description.es: The Love-Hate Pokémon. When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

description.en: The Grass Cat Pokemon. The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
description.es: The Grass Cat Pokemon. The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

description.en: The Grass Cat Pokémon. The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
description.es: The Grass Cat Pokémon. The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

description.en: The Magician Pokémon. With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.
description.es: The Magician Pokémon. With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

description.en: The Fire Croc Pokémon. It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
description.es: The Fire Croc Pokémon. It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

description.en: The Fire Croc Pokémon. The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
description.es: The Fire Croc Pokémon. The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

description.en: The Singer Pokémon. The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
description.es: The Singer Pokémon. The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

description.en: The Duckling Pokémon. This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
description.es: The Duckling Pokémon. This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

description.en: The Practicing Pokémon. These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
description.es: The Practicing Pokémon. These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

description.en: The Dancer Pokémon. A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
description.es: The Dancer Pokémon. A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

description.en: The Hog Pokémon. It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

description.en: The Paradox Pokémon. There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

description.en: The Paradox Pokémon. It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

description.en: The Paradox Pokémon. It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
